text:
Mike (Partnerships): hey team :wave: kicking off the cloud listing work for AWS/GCP/Azure. goal: get starter SKU + free trial live in staging by end of week. who can own artifact uploads and IAM perms?
Elena (Eng): I can handle the artifact side. need AMIs/containers and a short publish CLI. also need a list of expected seq lengths for perf profile.
Josh (Product): i'll own SKU naming, trial length, and the landing CTA. proposal: 14-day trial, tier=developer, sku=rw-inference-dev-14d. thoughts?
Sam (Marketplace): 14 days sounds fine. i'll prep publisher account + entitlement mapping. need an IAM role with s3 read to pull artifacts.
Mike (Partnerships): @Elena can you share the upload steps we want partners to follow? Sam i'll give you an account role after Elena confirms.
Elena (Eng): yes, minimal steps: build container, push to our artifact bucket, register manifest. example CLI:
```
rwd-cli publish \\
  --cloud aws \\
  --artifact s3://rwd-marketplace/artifacts/rw-inference-1.2.0.tar.gz \\
  --ami ami-0a1b2c3d4e \\
  --sku rw-inference-dev-14d
```
Elena (Eng): also the manifest needs fields: image_uri, sha256, model_family, min_gpu, seq_len_profile. i'll paste a JSON snippet in #docs later.
Josh (Product): legal question: do we need a custom EULA for marketplace or use standard Redwood EULA? tagging LegalBot.
LegalBot: Automated check: current listing requires EULA v2 (marketplace addendum). status: missing. Please attach signed addendum before publish.
Mike (Partnerships): ok will follow up with partner legal. Sam — can we stage the entitlement mapping without final EULA to validate telemetry?
Sam (Marketplace): yes, we can stage in sandbox account. i'll create a draft entitlement mapping and send to you. need display name, trial_days, metering dimensions.
Elena (Eng): FYI for AWS the AMI must be hardened and use our signing key. example AMI tag: `rwd-marketplace-prod-2026-03`. for GCP we need a GCE image name.
Josh (Product): branding assets: we need a 1200x627 hero, short description (<=300 chars), and 1-minute demo gif. i'll put assets in /shared/marketplace/partners/<partner-name>.
Mike (Partnerships): can someone own the rollout checklist? small checklist: 1) legal addendum signed, 2) artifacts uploaded, 3) manifest validated, 4) entitlement mapping staged, 5) pricing set, 6) smoke test pass.
Elena (Eng): i'll take #2 and #3.
Sam (Marketplace): i'll take #4 and help with #5.
Josh (Product): i'll do #1 (coordinate legal) and #6 (smoke tests with product flows).
Mike (Partnerships): perfect. rough ETA: Elena and Sam to complete staging steps by Thu 5pm PT, Josh to confirm legal by Fri EOD.
Elena (Eng): quick note: for perf testing please send sample prompt sets and target p95 latency. we'll run batch and streaming tests.
Josh (Product): sending prompt set link in #docs now. also adding pricing proposal: $0.15/1k tokens for starter. open to feedback.
LegalBot: Reminder: attach signed addendum as PDF named `partner-eula-addendum-<vendor>.pdf`.
Mike (Partnerships): thanks all. i'll update the shared tracker and ping legal if needed. :thumbsup:
Sam (Marketplace): staging role request: please create role `rwd-marketplace-publisher-staging` with S3:GetObject and KMS decrypt. once done i'll link account.
Elena (Eng): noted. i'll add the role ARN to the publish docs.
Mike (Partnerships): if anything blocks, drop a short note here. otherwise i'll close thread when staging is green.
Josh (Product): ack.
Elena (Eng): ack.
Sam (Marketplace): ack.
